footerDisplay: Commands run as the Homebridge service user. This beta does not automatically migrate cmdSwitch2 pairings.

name.title: Name
name.description: Keep the name unchanged to retain its HomeKit identity.

on_cmd.title: On Command
on_cmd.description: Switch ON action. For dimmers, ON uses the dimming command to restore the last nonzero level.

off_cmd.title: Off Command
off_cmd.description: OFF action. A dimmer without this command uses the dimming command with brightness 0.

state_cmd.title: State Command
state_cmd.description: Switch: exit 0 means ON, nonzero means OFF. Dimmer: exit 0 and print only a whole number from 0 to 100.

polling.title: Polling?
polling.description: Refresh state in the background. Polls never overlap.

interval.title: Poll interval (s)
interval.description: Seconds to wait after the previous state check finishes.

timeout.title: Post-command refresh delay (s)
timeout.description: Delay before checking state after a completed action. This does not acknowledge unfinished commands.

commandTimeout.title: Action deadline including queue time (s)
commandTimeout.description: Includes queue waiting. Failed and timed-out actions are reported to HomeKit.

strictState.title: Treat exit codes other than 0/1 as errors

dim_cmd.title: Dimming command (optional)
dim_cmd.description: Creates a lightbulb with brightness control. Read the requested percentage from $HB_BRIGHTNESS. Leave blank for a switch.

brightness.title: Initial brightness (%)
brightness.description: Used only when no cached level exists. ON restores the last nonzero level, or 100 if none is known.

maxConcurrentCommands.title: Maximum concurrent commands
maxConcurrentCommands.description: Used when sequential execution is off. Commands for one accessory are always serialized.

noLogs.title: No logs (routine messages)
noLogs.description: Optional: suppress startup, identify, state-change and successful-action messages. Errors remain visible; command text and output are never logged.

synchronous.title: Run commands sequentially
synchronous.description: Run one command at a time across this platform, including switches, dimmers and state checks. Queue waiting counts toward each deadline.

headerDisplay: Configure command switches and dimmers. Keep existing accessory names and types when restoring a cache.
